name: General Teddie
source:
A mysterious announcer, who looks suspiciously similar to [url=/c52190]Teddie[/url]. 

[Spoiler]His true identity is [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Hinokagutsuchi_(demon)]Hinokagutsuchi[/url], also known as Kagutsuchi and Homusubi, the god of fire in Japanese mythology. 
His mother, [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Izanami]Izanami[/url], burnt to death during childbirth. His father, [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Izanagi]Izanagi[/url], beheaded Kagutsuchi with his sword, and cut his body into eight pieces, which then became volcanoes. 

Kagutsuchi's corpse created many deities, including [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Take-Mikazuchi]Take-Mikazuchi[/url], the Shinto god of thunder, [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Futsunushi]Futsunushi[/url], a Shinto deity of swords, [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Amatsu_Mikaboshi]Amatsu Mikaboshi[/url], the god of stars in Japanese mythology, and [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Ouyamatsumi]Ouyamatsumi[/url], a god of mountains, sea, and war in Japanese mythology. 

Kagutsuchi is the patron deity of blacksmiths and ceramic workers. 

[Edited from [url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Hinokagutsuchi_(demon)#Persona_4_Arena_.2F_Ultimax]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

During the events of "[url=/v19951]Mayonaka Arena[/url]" and "[url=/v20164]Ultra Suplex Hold[/url]", he works with [url=/c53756]Minazuki Shou[/url] in his plan for revenge.[/spoiler]
